name: agent-browser
tagline_zh: AI 会点按钮、填表单、截屏抓数据，却常被登录墙卡住。这个 Skill 自带绕过机制，让 Agent 像人一样操作。
tagline_en: AI clicks, fills, screenshots, scrapes—but login walls stop it. This Skill adds a bypass, so your agent drives.
desc_en: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to
why_zh: 同类工具只给 API，它却内置了验证码和登录态处理，省去你手动接 Puppeteer 的麻烦。
why_en: Unlike bare APIs, it ships with captcha and session handling, so you skip the Puppeteer glue code.
